steps.text: Plantain (95/140 g) sliced thick on the diagonal, dry-griddled 3 minutes a side until black at the edges. Set aside.
Rapeseed oil (5/6 g) into a lidded pan, medium. Onion (30/40 g), 3 minutes.
Tomato (80/100 g), thyme and scotch bonnet, 4 minutes until it thickens.
Black beans (45/55 g) in. Spinach (130/160 g) in handfuls, each wilting before the next.
Make 2–3 wells with the back of a spoon. Crack the eggs (125/150 g — 2½ / 3) into them. Salt.
Lid on, heat low, 5 minutes. Whites set, yolks still moving.

why: Wells, not on top. Sitting the eggs down into the greens cooks them in trapped steam and they set evenly — dropped on the surface they slide, spread thin and overcook at the edge long before the middle goes.
notes: D0-003: the pan oil (single hot-pan use, softening onion) becomes rapeseed_oil.
